Name: Golden Claw
Description: The Saintly Crossbow of the Supernaturally Luminous Golden Claw.

Name: Hand Crossbow
Description: A compact off-hand crossbow.

Name: Heavy Crossbow
Description: A weighty crossbow with substantial force.

Name: Light Crossbow
Description: A light, dependable off-hand crossbow.

Name: Magic Crossbow
Description: Magic Bolts fired from this crossbow also deal Arcane damage.

Name: Pistol Crossbow
Description: A powerful crossbow in a compact frame.

Name: Repeating Crossbow
Description: Its magazine can fire two bolts after each basic attack.

Name: No OffHand
Description: No off-hand equipped.

Name: Copper Ley Rod
Description: A straight copper rod etched with ley-line marks. It steadies minor omens and strengthens early rune work.

Name: Dowsing Rod
Description: Also known as a divining rod, this oak Y-shaped branch is thought to help locate natural sources of water. But this is no normal dowsing rod, enhanced by the power of Poseidon. All water-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Gaia's Branch
Description: Mother Earth embodies all the living things, including the tree of life. As a sacrifice to combat those who try to hurt her, a single branch was removed and infused with the power of her domain. All earth-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Moonlit Hazel Rod
Description: Hazel harvested under a clear moon and capped with silver. It answers elemental signs with a quieter, stronger pulse.

Name: Photon Sphere Scepter
Description: Crafted to harness the pure, devastating power of the Photon Sphere spell, this scepter is an artifact of forbidden magic and unparalleled potency. The Photon Sphere Scepter channels immense energy directly into the spell, making it a weapon of unmatched finality in battle, doubling the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Rainbow Rod
Description: A radiant rod imbued with the essence of every elemental power, the Rainbow Rod amplifies the user's spells across all types, enhancing each with a vibrant, prismatic aura. All elemental spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Scepter of Ifrit
Description: A flaming scepter imbued by the wrath of Ifrit. All fire-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Willow Divining Rod
Description: A fresh willow switch wrapped in copper thread. It is humble work, but the forked tip answers many questions.

Name: Zephyruswand
Description: As the God of the West Wind, Zephyrus lends his power to user. All wind-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Aspis
Description: An aspis is a heavy wooden shield with a handle at the edge and is strapped to the forearm for greater mobility.

Name: Buckler
Description: A small round shield held by a handle or worn on the forearm.

Name: Glagwa
Description: A glagwa is a bell-shaped shield made from iron and covered with leather for improved durability.

Name: Kite Shield
Description: A kite shield is a large, almond-shaped shield rounded at the top and curving down to a point or rounded point at the bottom. The term "kite shield" is a reference to the shield's unique shape, and is derived from its supposed similarity to a flying kite.

Name: Medusa Shield
Description: A shield that has been polished to resemble a mirror. Said to be used to defeat the Gorgon Medusa. Reflects back some magic.

Name: Pavise
Description: A pavise is an oblong shield similar to a tower shield that features a spike at the bottom to hold it in place to provide full body protection.

Name: Svalinn
Description: The svalinn is a mythical shield that symbolizes protection and strength, often depicted as an essential element in the cosmic balance.

Name: Targe
Description: A targe is a circular, concave shield fitted with straps on the inside to be attached to the forearm, featuring metal studs on the face for durability and additional offensive power.

Name: Book
Description: A book of notes taken during the character's apprenticeship.

Name: Codex of Eternity
Description: A shimmering tome bound in starlight, with pages that shift and reform endlessly.

Name: Compendium of the Ancients
Description: A colossal tome filled with records of forgotten civilizations, written in a language lost to time.

Name: Dragon Rouge
Description: French for "Red Dragon", this mythical tome contains ancient knowledge passed down through the ages.

Name: Elemental Primer
Description: A multi-colored tome that shifts between elemental motifs depending on its surroundings.

Name: Infernal Grimoire
Description: A blackened, flame-wreathed book that burns to the touch but never turns to ash.

Name: Magus
Description: A book of magical art written by a powerful wizard.

Name: Necronomicon
Description: The Book of the Dead, a mystical grimoire written by an unknown author.

Name: Tome of Knowledge
Description: A tome containing secrets to enhancing spells.

Name: Treatise of Balance
Description: A weathered tome, marked with a taijitu, better known as the yin and yang symbol. The pages are filled with intricate diagrams illustrating the harmony of opposing forces.

Name: Vedas
Description: A large body of religious texts, consisting of some of the oldest holy teachings.
